subject.title: feat(github-copilot): add native web search for Copilot GPT models

question: Should eligible GitHub Copilot OpenAI Responses models automatically use Copilot-hosted search whenever web search is enabled and no managed provider is pinned?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but tests cannot decide whether changing existing users from managed-search dependence to automatic provider-hosted search is the intended privacy, quota, and routing policy.

options.title: Enable hosted search by default
options.body: Adopt the PR behavior while preserving managed-provider selection, disabled-search, tool-policy, and ineligible-model opt-outs.

options.title: Require explicit activation
options.body: Preserve current routing until users select native Copilot search through a maintainer-approved explicit surface.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep Copilot on managed search if automatic provider-hosted search does not fit the product policy.

recommendation.title: Enable hosted search by default
recommendation.body: Adopt the PR behavior while preserving managed-provider selection, disabled-search, tool-policy, and ineligible-model opt-outs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans the Copilot provider stream and provider SDK seams introduced and recently maintained by this owner.
